statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring to detect symptomatic arrhythmias underlying the palpitations and dizziness.
The service directly addresses the documented indications and supports medical necessity for the diagnosis of R00.2 with symptoms R42.
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229.
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197 for lack of required precertification or prior authorization.
